headline: WSN @ CIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 4.78 at CIN 4.81, with a projected total of 9.59. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: WSN moved -0.07 runs while CIN moved +0.32, changing the projected margin by -0.40 runs. NRFI probability rose +19.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chase Burns has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Elly De La Cruz, CJ Abrams, JJ Bleday, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nathaniel Lowe, Will Benson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
